links.outcome: Whether drift monitoring detects input distribution shifts and data quality problems in a deployed-style predictive model
links.effect: Univariate monitoring found respiratory rate shift from January 2022; multivariate PCA flagged three months, with data entry errors traced. Drift alerts did not coincide with the AUC dips in March 2020 and March 2021.
links.quote: In particular, multivariate monitoring surfaced data entry errors that were not detected by univariate methods and were absent from the training dataset, demonstrating how a comprehensive drift detection approach can uncover subtle or single-instance outliers.

links.outcome: Whether input data monitoring detects anomalous values and data pipeline integrity issues
links.effect: PCA reconstruction error flagged data entry errors (saturation '955' instead of '95', incorrect heart rate) and an outlier length of stay; after pipeline modification, alerts for those months were removed.
links.quote: After modifying the data pipeline to guard against these types of data entry errors, the multivariate alerts for these months were removed.
